cases.name: Eulalia Castellon
cases.about: Dedicated her life to helping underserved students in a predominately Spanish-speaking community. “Her service is to provide transportation for the kids,” Family friend, Maria Hernandez, told CBS12 News Wednesday. “She takes them to school, picked up them up, make sure they get home safe.”
cases.narrative: On 10/22/2023, her body was discovered inside a vehicle parked at the Lake Worth Tri-Rail Station in Lake Worth Beach, FL.
